title: 阪神大賞典の後に・長

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite winning the Hanshin Daishoten, Narita Brian's hunger is far from sated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, news drops that Mejiro McQueen and Mihono Bourbon are entering the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eager to race them, we decide to enter as well!
